validateImport (web ../hooks/validateImport) is ported byte-for-byte: clamp, isFinitePositive, sanitizeLayoutItem (x clamp 0..cols-1 / y / w clamp 1..cols / h clamp 1..8), and validateImportData with all six steps intact — JSON.parse guard ('Invalid JSON format'), object/array guard ('Expected a JSON object'), required name/widgets/layouts checks, the per-widget loop (widgetId string filter, unique-id generation with the Date.now()+Math.random() fallback and -dup suffix, config object narrowing), the registry availability split, the breakpointCols {lg:4,md:3,sm:2,xs:1} layout sanitiser keyed on availableIds, and the final SavedDashboard build (id import-${Date.now()}, name sliced to 100, ISO timestamps, isDefault:false). The only substitution is WIDGET_REGISTRY.map(def=>def.id) -> the inlined KNOWN_WIDGET_IDS set built from WIDGET_NAMES, so available/missing classification stays identical to the web registry. fromUrlSafeBase64 is re-expressed bitwise-free: base64url -> base64, feature-detected global atob (present on react-native-web, Hermes, and the Node test runner; throws when absent so the caller maps it to invalidUrl), then a percent-encode + decodeURIComponent UTF-8 rebuild matching the web TextDecoder().decode result for valid UTF-8.

WIDGET_NAMES inlines the full web widget id -> display-name registry data (117 entries across the 16 registry/*.ts files: alerts, analytics, automations, battery, charging, climate, commands, driving, energy, maps, media, security, system, telemetry, tires, vehicle) so the validator's availability classification (web validateImport L121-123) and the preview labels (web L344) are faithful; the per-widget lucide icons are dropped (DOM-only) and known widgets render a generic glyph / mini-grid dot. MiniGridPreview (web ./MiniGridPreview) ported: GRID_COLS.lg=4, the maxY = max(y+h) (default 2) + safeMaxY zero/NaN guard, the aspectRatio cols/safeMaxY container, and the per-item absolute percentage cells (left/top/width/height as DimensionValue, the MapRouteSummary cast convention); the web per-cell def.icon becomes a small accent dot for known widgets.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, @/lib/cn, Recharts, Leaflet, react-grid-layout, or web UI components are imported — only react, react-native primitives (Animated/Modal/Platform/Pressable/ScrollView/StyleSheet/TextInput/View + DimensionValue/ViewStyle types), and the existing apps/native SemanticIcon / AppText / theme tokens (colors/shadows/spacing). Browser-only globals (document file picker, atob) are runtime feature-detected behind globalThis guards (the JsonFormatter/useLogStream precedent). Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint . --quiet) exit 0; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles -> 16 suites / 71 tests passed.
